high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Google search page for "Sea butterflies." The top section of the image shows four photographs of sea butterflies, each with a unique coloration and shape. The background of these images is dark, which makes the sea butterflies stand out prominently. Below the images, there is an "Overview" section that provides a brief description of the sea butterflies. The text reads: "The Thecosomata, or sea butterflies, are a taxonomic suborder of small, pelagic, free-swimming sea snails known as holoplanktonic opisthobranch gastropod mollusks."
